none: PAS NLM-7A1DA6: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Preston
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [?DN?] CONST[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers, one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERC]ITVS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this small coin. Diameter: 15.1mm, Weight: 1.58gms, die axis: 12
